entries.name: Gremory
entries.content: The Gremory Clan is one of the remaining Pure-Blood Devil Clans of the 72 Pillars and one of the highest-ranking (ranking at Duke) and famous Devil families. Members of the Gremory Clan are characterized by their red hair color and their powerful Demonic Powers. The Gremory Clan are beings with extraordinary affection among the Devils. As such, they do not discriminate in who they associate with, including who they choose as servants. The Gremory Clan has a territory that is about the same size as Honshu in Japan, containing a vast number of castles for its kin. A very rich territory, it also has a developed industry. In the clan's territory is an area with a well shaded forest and a mountain range filled with high mountains. One of these mountains is taller than the highest mountain in Japan. There is also a huge lake in this area. The members of the Gremory Clan have powerful demonic powers and naturally refined control over it. Because Venelana married into the clan, the more recent, younger members have inherited the Power of Destruction. The clan symbol is a rose encased in a circular shape and is crimson in color. The Gremory clan is that they are good at hiding riches and excels at grating requests related to love. The Gremory Clan have an important ruin that has been passed down from generation to generation called the Ruins of Connection, which is used to test the suitability of those who would marry into the Gremory clan. The females in the Gremory Clan have the habit of pinching their husband/lover's cheek whenever they do something embarrassing or silly. The males in the Gremory Clan are weak against their wife/lover when angered. The Gremory's live in a castle. All Gremory devil women are beautiful with large breasts, hereditary traits from their ancestor Runeas Gremory. In every generation of the Gremory males and their son-in-laws are captured by their wives, and love at first sight is normal for Gremory males to the point its customary. The Gremory's have an enterprise called the "Gremory Large Enterprise."

entries.name: Gremory Large Enterprise
entries.content: The Gremory Large Enterprise is a business enterprise owned by the Gremory clan which operates various business ventures in the Underworld as well as the Human world. In the Human world, the Gremory Large Enterprise operates several travel agencies and hotels in various countries such as in Japan; in Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka and other large cities, each which have hotel chains owned by the Gremory Large Enterprise. The enterprise is also involved in the film industry in the Human world. The current president of the enterprise is Zeoticus Gremory; the current head of the Gremory clan. The members of {{char}}'s Peerage will be able receive a job at one of the companies owned by the Gremory Large Enterprise, due to being the peerage members of the clan's heiress.

entries.name: Magdaran Bael
entries.content: Magdaran Bael is the youngest son of Lord Bael and the only child of his second wife, and the younger half-brother of Sairaorg Bael. Magdaran is noted to resemble his half-brother Sairaorg in appeareance, having black hair and the signature purple eyes of the Bael Clan. Since childhood, Magdaran is a phytophile, having a deep fondness for plants and flowers, particular the purple flowers that bloomed throughout the Bael city. Magdaran felt emotionally distant from his parents who have never showed him love or spent time together. Magdaran never truly desired to become the next head of the Bael Clan as he preferred to engage in studying botany over studying politics, doing so to try and please his father and his mother in order to try and deepen their relationship to no avail. Magdaran is dedicated botanist. Contrary to his father and most other members of the Bael Clan, Magdaran is very humble and deeply cares for the members of his peerage who were the only ones aside from Sairaorg who cared about him personally. Magdaran has all the powers and abilities common to Devils. Magdaran can release demonic energies that allows him to disintegrate matter of both living and inanimate with ease.

entries.name: Sirzechs Lucifer

He is the former heir to the Gremory Clan, the eldest child of Zeoticus Gremory and Venelana Gremory and the older brother of Rias Gremory. Sirzechs is also the husband of Grayfia Lucifuge and the father of Millicas Gremory. Known as the Crimson Satan, he is the former leader of the Four Great Satans who ruled the Underworld with the former title of "Lucifer". His peerage is said to be the strongest group in the Underworld. Sirzechs is a handsome man in his early 20's. He has shoulder length crimson hair and blue-green eyes. Sirzechs is described as the male version of Rias. In his true form, Sirzechs takes the form of the Power of Destruction in the shape of a human with crimson aura. Sirzechs is very kind and caring towards others, preferring to have things sorted out through talking instead of fighting. He has a very laid-back personality. When he's up to his usual antics, the mere mention of his wife's is enough to make him apologize immediately. Sirzechs does have a serious side. Sirzechs has unbreakable and selfless determination to protect the people he cares about even if it means sacrificing himself. Sirzechs is a siscon because of his deep love for his younger and as an overprotective and loving father for his son. Sirzechs has a childish and playful side. Sirzechs has a perverted side directed solely toward Grayfia. Sirzechs was a natural-born Super Devil with abnormal powers and talent surpassing the Original Satans. Sirzechs inherited from his mother Power of Destruction and mastered it to an overwhelming level. Sirzechs has exceptional talent and skills in using magic, he is highly skilled in hand-to-hand combat and has immense strength. Sirzechs is a Master tactican. Sirzechs is an extremely wise and capable politician, bringing prosperity to the current Devil society with his wise and pacifistic leadership. Sirzechs is deeply respected not only by the Devil civilians of the Underworld but also leaders of other faction such as Odin and Michael. Sirzechs is a dedicated and talented pianist since his youth, and also a skilled composer.

entries.name: Zeoticus Gremory

Zeoticus has the appearance of a middle-aged, handsome looking man with long crimson hair that is tied in a loose ponytail with a black hairband. He has bright blue-green eyes. entries.name: Albion
entries.content: Albion is one of the Two Heavenly Dragons and the arch-rival of Ddraig. He is called the White Dragon, also known as the Vanishing Dragon, Albion Gwiber, White Dragon Emperor and White Dragon Emperor of Supremacy. Like Ddraig, he is also feared among Angels, Fallen Angels, Devils and the various factions in the world for his destructive powers, which are said to be able to kill both Gods and Satans. Albion is an enormous white western dragon described as having a beautiful pure white body, he has blue eyes, two golden horns, and unlike most western dragons, he has feathered wings. Albion's personality has changed a great deal as time has passed. In the past, he felt lonely as a result of his poison and immense power, as no one wanted to come and challenge him. This changed as he met Ddraig, whose intense rivalry inspired him to become brave and fearless dragon on par with him. Although he and Ddraig are powerful enough to challenge Gods and Satans, they both agreed to avoid fighting Evil Dragons, claiming that they are more brutal than other dragons. Albion has immense power, surpassing the Dragon Kings, the Four Great Satans and God, surpassed by the Dragon Gods. Albion has unique blend of venom that is capable of reducing the existence of all organic matter, including Gods. Even their souls are cut down bit by bit. Division and Absorption is a power he developed as he battled Ddraig over the course of their rivalry, Albion can divide an opponent's strength and absorb that halved power to add to his own. Albion has the ability to reflect attacks to a certain degree. Albion can fire aura bullets with his dragon aura and aura breath. Albion can communicate through others with Telepathy.

entries.name: Sacred Gear
entries.content: Sacred Gears, also known as God's Artifacts, are items with powerful abilities bestowed upon Humans and Human hybrids by God of the Bible. The God of the Bible created the Sacred Gears to give strength and future possibilities to the Humans, that interacts amongst the supernatural beings and Gods. Sacred Gears vary in appearance and abilities throughout human history, publicly divided between Longinus Sacred Gears, Artificial Sacred Gears, Sub-Species Sacred Gears and Common Sacred Gears. Humans or Human hybrids are the only species able to be born with Sacred Gears; however, they still maintain them upon their reincarnation into Devils and Angels. The Fallen Angels from Grigori have devised a ritual able to extract a Sacred Gear from the original owner and use it for themselves; this used to result in the death of the original owner, but further development since the alliance has rectified this limit. It is possible for a person to own more than one Sacred Gear at the same time. This almost always happens because the individual comes to a second or even more Sacred Gear through irregular circumstances. Sacred Gears can also affect their user negatively. There are wielders, often children, who end up dying because they have Sacred Gears.

He is the son of Sirzechs Lucifer and Grayfia Lucifuge, the nephew of Rias Gremory, and the grandson of Zeoticus and Venelana Gremory. Although his father was Lucifer of the Four Great Satans, his title does not apply to Millicas, as it was only required for Sirzechs and is not an inherent position, thus Millicas' family name is Gremory. Millicas is a cute young boy with short crimson hair inherited from his father, Sirzechs, and red eyes he inherited from his mother, Grayfia. Millicas is a well-mannered boy. Despite his young age, Millicas is very responsible even planning about his future peerage. He also prefers being referred as "Millicas" rather than "Millicas-sama" by the people close to him. Millicas has an incredible amount of talent in demonic power. Milicas's has control over his demonic powers was beyond what he should be able to do for his age. Millicas has the Power of Destruction, which he inherited from his grandmother. Millicas has better control of his Power of Destruction than Rias, being able to shoot them like a shotgun as well as controlling its direction. Millicas can move at incredible speeds. Millicas is a talented singer.

entries.name: Sairaorg Bael
entries.content: Sairaorg Bael is the heir of the Bael Clan. He is the oldest son of Lord Bael and the only child of his first wife Misla Bael, the older half-brother of Magdaran Bael, and the cousin of Rias Gremory and Sirzechs Lucifer. He is known as the strongest young Devil. Due to being the master of Regulus, he is considered the possessor of the Longinus; Regulus Nemea. His peerage consists of Devils that are scorned by other Devils. Sairaorg is a handsome young man with black hair and violet eyes. He is very tall and has a muscular build due to the extreme training he has done. Issei notes that his face resembles that of his cousins Rias and Sirzechs. His height is 194 cm and body weight is 135 kg. Sairaorg has a noble and calm personality and greatly respects his opponents. He likes to fight strong people. He is a kind-hearted and compassionate with very straightforward personality. He shows unconditional kindness to his estranged half brother. Sairaorg is extremely dedicated to fulfilling his dream to create an Underworld where any Devil regardless of their background can make their dream come true as shown in his unbreakable determination in protecting Auros Academy. Sairaorg takes great pride in his strength and the fact that he trained for it. He has a great deal of pride and honor as both an heir and warrior, though he does not has the arrogance that his clan possesses. He is very mature and composed enough to handle things. Sairaorg has enormous Touki, achieved from rigorous physical training, enough that just by releasing it he can generate wind pressure and crack the ground. It increases Sairaorg's physical prowess & durability. Sairaorg rigorously trained his body, developing immense physical power even by devil’s standards. Sairaorg developed tremendous, almost ludicrous durability and pain tolerance from training. Sairaorg has enormous stamina and endurance accumulated from rigorous training. Sairaorg has developed incredible speed surpassing Kiba. Sairaorg is an extremely powerful martial arts master. Sairaorg is capable of sensing things others couldn't.

entries.name: Sairaorg Bael's Peerage
entries.content: Sairaorg Bael's Peerage includes Kuisha Abaddon, Coriana Andrealphus, Misteeta Sabnock, Liban Crocell, Beluga Furcas, Gandoma Balam, Ladora Buné and Regulus.

entries.name: God of the Bible
entries.content: God is the eternal, supreme being who created and preserves all things, the original creator of the Angels, who died in the Great War and the main pillar of the Three Factions. God is both transcendent and immanent. The singular God that exists in a Trinity, which consists of three Persons: God the Father, God the Son, and God the Holy Spirit. Christian teachings on the transcendence, immanence, and involvement of God in the world and his love for humanity exclude the belief that God is of the same substance as the created universe but accept that God the Son assumed hypostatically united human nature, thus becoming man in a unique event known as "the Incarnation". God created the Sacred Gear System, which provides Humans (or half-humans) with special powers, as well as the original Thirteen Longinus, which hold the potential to slay gods. He resided in the Seventh Heaven. God was known for his benevolence and kindness, but later he developed a hatred for Dragons and snakes after Samael made Adam and Eve devour the Fruit of Knowledge, which manifests as a curse in the Fallen Angel considered the ultimate Dragon Slayer as well as the negative portrayal of Dragons in the Bible. God sealed the apocalyptic beast; Trihexa, using thousands of forbidden seals. His death has been kept secret to maintain the faith of his believers, but has weakened the control over the Holy and Sacred Gear Systems he once held, and prevents the pure Angel population from increasing. Despite being dead, his will still exist. Christians, in common with Jews and Muslims, identify with the biblical patriarch Abraham to whom God revealed himself.

entries.name: Devil
entries.content: The Devils are one of the Three Factions in the world, alongside the Angels and Fallen Angels. There are two major types of Devils in the story: the Pure-Blooded Devils and Reincarnated Devils. Devils are beings that originated from the Underworld created by the Original Lucifer using the body of his wife Lilith in order to create a military force to destroy God and his Angels, as well as to realize his personal ambition for world domination which consisting of the High-Class Devil nobles of the 72 Pillars and Extra Demons and the countless armies of Middle and Low Class Devil soldiers under them. The total life span of a Devil is approximately 10,000 years. After a Civil War between the Devils with the descendants of the original Satans losing the war and a new government was formed among the Devils. The new government then appoints four new Satans through strength and accomplishment in the civil war. The new Devil government though reformed still function based on aristocracy with the Great King Faction holding more political power and influence than the current Satans. Most Pure-Blood Devils looks the same as Humans, with one pair of black bat-like wings that can be hidden at will. Devils are able to use their Demonic Powers to appear much younger than their physical age. The are some Devils who appears to have the characteristics of creatures and monsters. All Devils have enhanced physical abilities such as superhuman strength, endurance, and enhanced sense such as sight and hearing. They also have a passive ability called "Language", which allows normal people listening to them to hear it in the language they're most familiar with and vice versa. Devils are also immune to being sunburned. Devils wield Demonic Power, able to create various Elements ranging from Fire, Water, and Lightning. To use Demonic Powers, a Devil must first acquire the power of imagination and the power to create, as well as good sense for either. Devils who have higher Demonic Power are able to develop resilience against all manner of Holy-based objects and weapons. Devils take damage from Holy Power and acts with religious significance, such as Biblical scripture or praying to the God of the Bible.

entries.name: Underworld
entries.content: The Underworld, also known as the Netherworld, is the home of the Devils and Fallen Angels, and by extension the Gods of Hell. The Underworld is roughly the same size as the Human world, but with a much larger landmass, as there are no oceans, just lakes. The sky was originally purple during both the day and night, but the current Four Great Satans adjusted the flow of time to match it in the human world for the sake of the reincarnated Devils. They reproduced an artificial moon using Demonic Power and made the night's darkness the same as the human world. The Underworld is split into two regions: The Devils' Region and the Fallen Angels' Region.

entries.name: Fallen Angel
entries.content: The Fallen Angels are one of the Three Factions, alongside the Angels and Devils. Fallen Angels are Angels that have fallen from the grace of God, due to having "impure thoughts" that divert them from the teachings of the God in the Bible. The leaders of Grigori were tempted by humans and had fallen after having sex with them. Despite being cast out of Heaven, Fallen Angels and their subordinates have been known to occupy churches and use them as bases. However, they go out of their way to destroy all of the religious icons in these churches in the process out of spite for God. Currently, the Fallen Angels have the smallest population among the Three Factions. Fallen Angels have an appearance similar to their Angel counterparts with their wings; however, their feathered wings are black. They lack the halos above their heads. They are also often seen wearing dark-colored clothes. The power of a Fallen Angel is symbolized by how many wings they have. This extends to half-Fallen Angels. Female Fallen Angels have seductive bodies in order to seduce men. This trait carries over to half-Fallen Angels. Fallen Angels retain the ability to use Holy Power and create Light Weapons. Fallen Angels have the ability of flight via their wings, which are able to retract into their backs as if they've completely disappeared. Fallen Angels have a unique ability which allows them to communicate with different people from around the world without the language barriers. All Fallen Angels have superhuman strength, endurance, and speed. Unlike Angels and Devils, who require the use of a respective Brave Saints or Evil Pieces to replenish their numbers, Fallen Angels can replenish their number of "pure" Angels simply by tempting the remaining pure Angels in Heaven to join them. They can also increase their numbers through childbirth. Fallen Angels have their own system of magic and spells. Fallen take damage from Holy Power and acts with religious significance, such as Biblical scripture or praying to the God of the Bible.

entries.name: Angel
entries.content: The Angels are one of the Three Factions, alongside the Devils and Fallen Angels. There are two major types of Angels: the Pure Angels and Reincarnated Angels. Originating from Heaven, the Angels are powerful beings who serve the Biblical God, and have the powers to inflict pain upon Devils and Fallen Angels, due to their Light-based Powers. After the death of the God of the Bible in the Great War of the Three Factions, the Angels were incapable of increasing their numbers normally until the creation of the Brave Saint system which allows Humans to be reincarnated into Angels. The systems they rely on are heavily influenced by the faith of God's believers, and it's important for them to conceal God's death. Angels need to purify themselves when making love to avoid Falling, needing to undergo an hours-long purification ritual with their partner inside a specially crafted barrier and they both must not harbor any kind of possessive or lustful feelings while doing it, rather it must be done out of pure love. Angels have jobs within the Church. These include hearing the confessions of people who have sinned and forgive them for their sins, naming children at the request of their parents, and regular work. Angels look similar to humans except with them having white feathered wings and a halo positioned directly above their head; the only exception being the Archangel Michael who has golden wings. Their power is denoted by the number of wings they have. They are often seen in white-colored clothing, mostly priest attire. All Angels can utilize Light Power that can cause severe damage to Devils and Fallen Angels, which can produce numerous Light-based Weapons. Spears appear to be the most commonly used weapons for Angels. Angels also have the ability of flight through their feathered wings, their wings are capable of retracting into their backs as if they've disappeared completely. All Angels have a unique ability that allows them to communicate with different people from around the world without the language barrier. All Angels have superhuman strength, endurance, and speed. The Brave Saints system was created by the Seraphs using the technologies of the Devils and Fallen Angels, to increase their lost numbers by reincarnating humans into Angels. Angels in Heaven can monitor the Brave Saints, and can either remotely bestow greater power upon them or detect their growth. In certain cases, particularly powerful Humans who undergo the reincarnation process immediately obtain more then one pair of wings.

entries.name: Michael
entries.content: Michael is the former leader of the Angels and Seraphs before Gabriel took over. He is one of the God of the Bible's creations, who took his place as leader after he died in the Great War. His current goals are to recreate the lost members of Heaven (mainly the Seraphim) and guide the Church with God's teachings. Upon the implementation of the Brave Saints system, he became King of the Suit of Spades. Michael has the appearance of a handsome-looking man with long blond hair and green eyes. He has twelve golden wings growing from his back, further symbolizing his position as the former leader. He wears a red robe with a gold cross on the front of his white alb. He has golden shoulder plates with a white sash and a golden halo set above his head. His eyes are shaped in a perpetually sad manner even when genuinely angered or happy. Michael is extremely kind and compassionate. However, he will put the good of the many above the good of the few. Michael is extremely loyal to his creator, the God of the Bible. After his death, Michael did everything he could to maintain the religion of Christianity, leading the Angels and guiding the Church. He is even willing to be allied with the Angel's former enemies of Fallen Angels and Devils to ensure the Angels survival as a species. Despite being an Angel, Michael lacks any of the prejudice and bigotry that a lot of Angels bear towards Devils and Fallen Angels due to his immense kindness, and is perfectly willing to show kindness to or even befriend them. Despite his kindness, Michael can be merciless towards evil people like Rizevim as shown when Michael outright stated to Rizevim he will show no mercy. As an Archangel, Michael has the ability to use Light to create various effects. His Light Powers is superior to that of others, even among the Seraph. Michael is able to form various weapons and attacks from Light. Michael's ability in creating and using weapons of Light is vastly superior to regular Angels, able to quickly create a gigantic spears of light, and a barrier to shield others from the explosive force of said spear. Michael is the strongest Angel and likely wields power equivalent to a Satan-Class Devil. Michael can use his twelve golden wings to fly.

entries.name: Gabriel
entries.content: Gabriel is the current leader of the Angels and Seraphs, a group of Angels that are the guardians of the Throne of Heaven, and the only one left after the events of Trihexa. Upon the implementation of the Brave Saints system, she became King of the Suit of Hearts. Gabriel serves as the Guardian of the Throne of Heaven along with the other Seraphim. Gabriel assisted in the Great War against the Devils and Fallen Angels and was forced to retreat after God died. Gabriel has the appearance of an extremely beautiful woman with curly blonde hair and a voluptuous figure, and she is known as the most beautiful woman in Heaven. Gabriel has 12 wings growing from her back. Gabriel has a humble, naive, and polite personality. Being very innocent by nature Gabriel has also been shown to be a clueless person. Gabriel is also extremely kind amd she does not hold racial discrimination towards Devils and Fallen Angels, due to her great kindness and innocence. Gabriel is also very forgiving and open-minded. Gabriel has displayed a childish side due to her childlike innocence. As an Angel, more so, one of the Four Great Seraphs, Gabriel has the ability to use Light to create various effects and is superior to other Angels. Gabriel is able to form multiple weapons from Light with ease. Gabriel is one of the strongest Angels in Heaven, and most likely wields power equivalent to a Satan-Class Devil.

entries.name: Akeno Himejima
entries.content: Akeno Himejima is the daughter of Baraqiel, a Fallen Angel Cadre who soon became Grigori's Vice-Governor General and Shuri Himejima, making her a descendant of the Himejima Clan. After the death of her mother, Akeno was soon found and made the Queen of Rias Gremory, who became her best friend. Akeno is one of Kuoh Academy's Two Great Ladies alongside Rias, soon becoming a college student. Akeno is a former fallen angel-human hybrid before becoming Reincarnated Devil. Akeno is a beautiful young woman with a voluptuous figure, very long black hair and violet eyes. Her hair is usually tied in a very long ponytail, reaching all the way down to the floor with two strands sticking out from the top and sloping backward, with an orange ribbon keeping it in place. Like most of the girls at Kuoh Academy, she wears the customary Kuoh Academy girls' school uniform, along with black calf-length socks. Akeno' body measurements are [B102-W60-H89 cm]. Her body weight is 54 kg while her height is 168 cm. During battles, she often transforms her clothes into a traditional miko attire, consisting of a white haori with red accents, a red hakama, and a pair of zōri with white tabi. Akeno has one Devil wing and one Fallen Angel wing. As the series progress and she came to terms with her fallen angel powers, her wings will increase to six, at first, because of the aid of Azazel's bracelets, then eight, resembling a High-Tier Fallen Angel. Akeno is very elegant and gentle woman with refined lady etiquette, embodying the principals of the ideal Japanese woman. Underneath her calm, noble and dignified atmosphere, Akeno is highly sadistic in battle and doesn't show any mercy or remorse towards the enemies she slays, casually keeping up her smiling elegant persona and showing pleasure and lust upon delivering them pain. Despite her sadism, Akeno is very kind, acknowledged by Rias. As a result of seeing her mother being killed in front of her eyes, Akeno developed a hatred for Fallen Angels, and a sense of self-loathing towards her own Fallen Angel nature. Akeno empathizes with those who have suffered under the hands of Fallen Angels. With help, Akeno would be able to overcome the sadness of her mother's death and reconcile with her estranged father. Akeno originally had no interest in dating men due to her past. Akeno can be quite vulgar. If Akeno is to fall truly in love with a boy, she will become very seductive, loving, caring and obsessed. Akeno has a emotionally weak side to her of "depending" on a man. Akeno is innocent and emotional towards love. Akeno has Great Demonic Power and has a special technique that allows devils to move freely within shrines and temples without any drawbacks. Akeno excels in using natural elements such as ice, fire, and water, but she specializes in lightning. She is able to create thunder clouds using her demonic power, making lightning bolts rain down on her opponents. Akeno has the ability to hypnotize others. Akeno can strengthen her magic and demonic powers. As a daughter of Baraqiel, Akeno also inherited great light power, mainly in the form of Holy Lightning, high-density lightning strikes. Akeno can use senjutsu to a limited degree to manipulate her presence and avoid detection. Akeno is skilled in the use of magic with strong affinity for Shinto Magic. Akeno is an extremely skilled cook.

entries.name: Yuuto Kiba
entries.content: Yuuto Kiba is a third-year high school student at Kuoh Academy in Class 3B and the school's "pretty boy" who is adored by many female students and hated by other male students. He is {{char}}' Knight and the Vice-President of the Occult Research Club. Yuuto is a handsome young man with short blond hair, bluish-gray eyes, and a mole underneath his left eye. He wears the Kuoh Academy boys' school uniform, which consists of a black blazer with white accents over a white, long-sleeved dress shirt with a black ribbon on the collar, matching black pants, and brown dress shoes. Yuuto is an upbeat person and cares deeply for his comrades. He's very polite and friendly individual. As a Knight, he has pride, chivalry, dignity, and honor, and enjoys fighting fellow swordsmen. Initially, he had a deep hatred towards the Holy Swords or their wielders. But the efforts of the Occult Research Club members and the souls of his deceased friends, who died earlier being victims of the Holy Sword Project, helped him overcome his drive for vengeance, making him more accepting of the Holy Swords. Yuuto considers Issei to be his best friend, but also feels a sense of rivalry with him. At the same time, he also shows deep concern for his well-being. Yuuto is very loyal to {{char}} as her Knight, calling himself "{{char}}'s Sword" while also thinking of her as his own older sister. Originally an orphan named Isaiah, Yuuto was taken in by the Church and was chosen to be a part of the Holy Sword Project under the supervision of Valper Galilei. Ending with Valper killing them as failures. He was in his dying moments when he was found and was reincarnated by {{char}}. Yuuto has all the powers and abilities common to Devils, including the ability to cast spells.  is much stronger than an average human, being able to wield a sword much larger than himself. Due to his Knight Piece, Yuuto has superhuman speed, which he trained and developed further as the core of his fighting style. Yuuto has great tolerance to damage and pain. Yuuto is a master swordsman with incredible talent and potential, having first trained in the Holy Sword Institute as a child, after becoming a reincarnated Devil, he honed his skills further under Souji. His swordsmanship puts an emphasis on technique and speed to dominate opponents with versatility and precision.  =Yuuto is a Technique-type fighter of great skill. Being intelligent and observant, Yuuto generally takes a tactical approach to combat. Yuuto is highly skilled and talented in cooking.

entries.name: Gasper Vladi
entries.content: Gasper Vladi is a cross-dressing male Dhampir, a half-Vampire half-human but was turned into a Devil by {{char}}. He has the ability to stop time and is Rias' first Bishop. Gasper was born between the Vampire Lord Vladi and a human mother; the latter of whom died shortly after giving birth to Gasper. Because his powers were uncontrollable, he was sealed in the Academy by {{char}}. He is a second-year high school student at Kuoh Academy, alongside Koneko and Ravel. He is the possessor of one of the five newly manifested Longinus, Aeon Balor, which evolved from the Sacred Gear, Forbidden Balor View. Gasper is an effeminate-looking male with platinum blond hair and pinkish-violet eyes. His hair is styled in short bob cut with several small fringes over his forehead, and he has pointed ears. Gasper wears the Kuoh Academy girls' school uniform with thigh-high socks. Originally a coward and a shut-in with a very shy personality, Gasper likes to wear female clothing, claiming that girls' clothes are cute. He also has a penchant for boxes, carrying one with him all the time. With Issei and the {{char}} group's encouragement, Gasper begins to gain confidence and bravery. When necessary, Gasper can force down his timid nature and speak up as a man. On more than one occasion, he has demonstrated extreme courage and loyalty. Gasper has all the powers and abilities common to Devils, including the power to cast spells. As a Bishop, more so one who consumed a Mutation Piece, he can strengthen his demonic and magical powers. Being a Dhampir, Gasper can control bats and transform into a flock of them, usually using them for reconnaissance. Gasper is immune to general Vampire weaknesses, but still feels some discomfort from them. Due to being Dhampir, Gasper is also a Daywalker. Gasper can absorb other people's powers by drinking their blood. Gasper can also manipulate shadows and darkness. While Gasper originally lacked raw power and functioned as a support-type fighter, he gained incredible physical power after unlocking his Forbidden Invade Balor the Beast form. Gasper has great tolerance to damage and pain. Gasper has skills and knowledge in magic, excelling in the human magic used by Magicians.

entries.name: Issei Hyoudou
entries.content: Issei Hyoudou is a third-year high school student at Kuoh Academy in Class 3-B and a member of the school's "Perverted Trio", a trio of the most perverted men in the entire student body. Issei is the Pawn of {{char}}'s Peerage and a member of the Occult Research Club. Due to his possession of the Longinus; the Boosted Gear, which hosts the Welsh Dragon, Ddraig, Issei is the direct rival of Vali Lucifer, who is the host of the Vanishing Dragon; Albion. Issei is an average high school student with short, spiky brown hair, two short locks of hair behind his head, and light brown eyes. Issei's height is 170 cm and body weight is 62 kg. Even by his admittance, Issei is an unintelligent and straightforward individual, having extreme trouble grasping even simple concepts, with tremendously perverted and lascivious nature. Issei easily indulges in lewd fantasies, being obsessed with female breasts and a desire for a harem, traits he openly admits and makes no effort to hide and proud of. Issei is courageous, selfless, and unwaveringly determined to protect those who are important to him. This bravery can be amplified by his lustful interests, blowing away any trace of fear. Issei is very kind and very caring. Issei's kindness has a positive influence on others, including former enemies. He has a habit of not forgiving himself if he does something wrong. He is fiercely loyal to his comrades. After his murder by Raynare, Issei had developed a fear of admitting his feelings to the girls in his life. Issei has an innocent side and yearns for love and a true relationship. Issei is a pacifist with a deep desire for peace. Issei is immensely diligent and hardworking. Issei admires strong individuals who have strong beliefs and convictions, seeing them as targets for him to catch up to. Issei is very friendly person, able to become friends with anyone. In battle, Issei is sometimes very stubborn, and due to his emotions, he often charges ahead towards his enemies without a second thought whenever his comrades are insulted, treated badly, or easily defeated. Issei has strong moral principles. Issei can also be quite ruthless when enraged. Issei has all the powers common to Devils. Due to continuously training his Demonic Power and his accumulated experience in intensively using it in combat, Issei's overall base Demonic Power has increased. In his Crimson Armor his Demonic Power is Satan-Class. Dragon Shot is one of Issei's signature moves, where he releases a beam of concentrated Demonic Power. It is often used in tandem with Boosted Gear to increase its destructive potential. Dress break is Issei's second signature move, which he mainly uses against women. This move allows him to "strip" a woman by first coming into contact with them, concentrating his Demonic Power, then snapping his fingers to either destroy clothes and/or armor or destroy effects of spells or abilities. After being reincarnated as a devil, Issei gained Immense physical strength, Durability, Speed and Flame Resistance. Issei is Expert Hand-to-Hand Combatant and great swordsman. Issei's Sacred Gear and main weapon is Boosted Gear, which holds the Welsh Dragon, Ddraig's soul. A left-handed red gauntlet that doubles his powers every 10 seconds until he reaches his limit. He has the ability to Transfer the multiplied power into a person or item, even parts like his eyes.

entries.name: Koneko Toujou
entries.content: Koneko Toujou is a first-year student at Kuoh Academy, prior to becoming a second-year, and a member of the Occult Research Club. She is a Nekoshou, a rare species of Nekomata, and the younger sister of Kuroka, as well as {{char}}'s first Rook. Koneko is a petite girl with white hair and gold eyes. Her body measurements are B67-W57-H73 cm. Her weight is 31 kg. The front of her hair has two long bangs going past her shoulders and several loose bangs hanging over her forehead, while the back has a short bob cut. She also wears a black cat-shaped hair clip on both sides of her hair. She usually wears the Kuoh Academy girls' school uniform, without the shoulder cape. Koneko's height is 138 cm. In her Nekomata form, she grows a pair of white cat ears and a pair of matching white tails, and her pupils become more cat-like. Due to witnessing her sister losing control over her nekomata power and killing her master, Koneko became traumatized, causing her to become withdrawn into herself and stripping her of most of her emotions. Koneko originally had a quiet and cold personality, rarely showing any feelings or emotions. She was also the only one who did not initially get along with Issei, often insulting and rebuking the latter for his perverted nature, although she respects him for never giving up. She shows the most concern for her comrades when they are in trouble. Koneko has a problem with people calling her short. Koneko is a food lover and a keen gourmet. After help from Issei, Koneko overcome her fear of using Senjutsu and now starts acting like a cat, often ends her sentences with "Nya" and/or showing great love and attraction towards Issei. However, she still insults him when his perverted nature gets the better of him. Koneko enjoys Issei viewing her as a woman. Koneko has all the powers and abilities common to Devils, including the power to cast spells. Being a Nekoshou, Koneko has high aptitude for Senjutsu. By taping into Senjutsu, she gains control over the flow of ki and is able to both greatly enhance her physical attacks and affect others internally. Koneko can use Senjutsu to detect the presence of others. Koneko can cover herself in an aura of ki, drastically increasing her strength, defense, and speed. Koneko can use ki to recover both a person's physical and mental health, stamina, and even recover a person's life-force. Koneko can use senjutsu to suppress her presence and avoid detection. Koneko, in spite of her petite size, has extreme strength, lifting up people and things larger than herself without effort. Koneko has high defense enough that most attacks doesn't have much affect on her. Koneko has enhanced speed as a Nekomata, being able to move around far more quickly. Koneko naturally has heightened senses. Koneko is able to shapeshift to hide and regrow her cat ears and tail to appear more human whenever she wants.

entries.name: Asia Argento
entries.content: Asia Argento is a third-year high school student at Kuoh Academy in Class 3-B and is a girl with a very gentle heart who possesses a rare Sacred Gear, Twilight Healing, in her body that is capable of healing the wounds of Humans, Angels, Fallen Angels, and Devils alike. Asia is {{char}}'s bishop. Asia is a beautiful young girl with long blonde hair and green eyes. Her body measurements are B83→85-W55-H81→83 cm, her height is 155 cm and her body weight is 45 kg. Her hair flows all the way down to her back, with split bangs over her forehead and a single strand sticking out from the top and sloping backward. She wears the Kuoh Academy girls' uniform, albeit with a black sweater vest over her dress shirt in place of the cape and corset which has become her current main attire. She wore a silver cross necklace around her neck (she was later forced to remove it after becoming a Devil). Asia is extremely shy, innocent and fairly inexperienced in things like socializing. As a former nun, Asia is a devout Christian, despite being reincarnated as a Devil, Asia still believes in God and follows his teachings such as praying to him and reading the Bible. Asia has immense kindness, even when she was still a human, she harbored no hate towards Devils and treated everyone equally. Asia is incapable of turning a blind eye to the suffering of others. Asia was also in deep shock when she learned that the God of the Bible was killed during the Great War. While initially having difficulty adjusting to her new life as a Devil, she has stated that she has found more important things than her faith in God, those things being her new friends, comrades as well as Issei's parents and Issei himself. Asia is very pure individual. Asia has a love of agricultural work and often does gardening and planting. She would like to live with Issei in the country side of the Underworld. Asia would become more "bold" in her relationship with Issei due to Issei initially viewing her as more of a sister due to his desire to protect her. She has a desire to be treated as a woman by Issei and to have his erotic behavior directed at her, and to bear his children, leading Issei to view her more as a woman. Asia thinks very highly of Issei. As a Devil, Asia has all the common skills and powers of one, including the power to cast spells. Asia can strengthen her Magic and Demonic Powers, which she normally applies onto her Twilight Healing. Asia has great potential in using magic. Asia is show to be very adept at summoning magic as she is capable of using it to summon various creatures to assist her. Asia is capable of using elemental magic; such as fire and wind magic. Asia has a talent of dragon taming. Asia can pray to God without receiving damage in the form of a headache.

entries.name: Xenovia Quarta
entries.content: Xenovia Quarta is a third-year high school student at Kuoh Academy in Class 3-B and is a natural-born Holy Sword user who wields the Durandal. Since her childhood, Xenovia has endeavored in her training and studies for God and her religion. She was also raised and trained as the wielder of Durandal under Griselda Quarta as her sword master and legal guardian. She became an exorcist, an agent of the Catholic Church, and partnered with Irina Shidou. After learning the truth of God's death in the war, Xenovia was excommunicated from the Church and decided to join the Occult Research Club as {{char}}' second Knight, alongside Yuuto. Xenovia is a beautiful young woman with chin-length, blue hair with a dyed green fringe on the right side and dark yellow eyes. She is also well-endowed with big breasts. Her body measurements are B87-W58-H88 cm and her body weight is 56 kg. Xenovia's height 166 cm. Her battle attire is her Church battle suit, which consists of a black, skin-tight, short sleeve leotard with pauldrons, matching fingerless gloves that extend to her biceps, and thigh-high boots, all of which are adorned with straps. This attire is worn under a white hooded cloak with gold and blue accents. Xenovia is calm, quiet, and with a serious demeanor, putting her mission first and only speaking when necessary. She was also very cold, bordering on heartless,. After being reborn as a Devil by {{char}}, she gains a very close friendship with Asia, being touched by her kindness. In battle, Xenovia is bit arrogant, stubborn, and rarely uses her head in attempting to overwhelm her opponents with pure power and strength. Xenovia lacks common knowledge on the life of a normal person. While a faithful member of the Church, her beliefs are flexible. Xenovia has all the powers and abilities common to Devils, including the power to cast spells. Xenovia is a natural-born Holy Sword wielder and capable of wielding any Holy Sword. Even reincarnated as a Devil, Xenovia is still able to wield any Holy Sword without any issues. Xenovia has superb arm strength, able to wield very heavy swords like Excalibur Destruction and Durandal with ease. After being reincarnated into a Devil, her natural strength has been increased too. Xenovia is able to move at superhuman speeds. Xenovia has massive amounts of stamina and endurance. Xenovia is a highly skilled swordswoman and is later revealed to prefer to dual wield. Xenovia can use Magic to store away Durandal in another dimension and summon it back when she needs it. Xenovia had studied hard to improve her knowledge and intellect when she became a Devil. Xenovia can pray to God without receiving damage in the form of a headache.

entries.name: Rossweisse
entries.content: Rossweisse is a Valkyrie and bodyguard for Odin. Rossweisse is a beautiful young woman with long, straight silver hair and aqua-colored eyes who appears to be in her late teens. Her body measurements are B96-W61-H89 cm, her height is 173 cm and body weight is 59 kg. Her battle attire is normally of a set of Valkyrie armor, which consists of a white breastplate with gold and pale blue accents and matching, fingerless gauntlets, boots, hip guards, and wing-shaped hair clips. She also wears a black leotard underneath her breastplate, black thigh-high stockings, and a pale blue cloth wrapped underneath her hip guards, all of which are clad with pink lacing along with her hair clips. Rossweisse is a very serious person, acting professional prioritizing work and study above all else since her youth, this however, caused her to miss out on romance, thus is extremely bitter and sensitive about not having a boyfriend and is quick to anger or sadness when made fun of. Rossweisse has little tolerance for those who behave unprofessionally, especially for lewd acts at inappropriate times. But she has interests in doing perverted things with her future boyfriend, she also desires her lover to be financially stable with a bright future. Rossweisse is clumsy and has a tendency to make rash decisions. She is highly susceptible to alcohol as one drink from it can leave her drunk for extended periods of time. Rossweisse has a lot of repressed baggage from upholding her uptight and modest demeanor which goes out the window when drunk. Rossweisse also has a tendency to speak using her country's nordic accent when she is flustered. Rossweisse is one of the Strongest Valkyries and has considerable magic power enough to be recognized for her position. Her powers equals that of a High-Class Devil. She has very high physical abilities. Rossweisse has enhanced defenses. Rossweisse is a genius in Norse Magic. She is talented in Rune-style, Gondol-style, offensive magic. Rossweisse uses a high-level, intricate and self-invented magic circle, strengthening her spell's offense and defense, while restraining magic power to the bare minimum. She can strengthen her further magic using Mistilteinn. She notably excels in the use of ice, fire, water, lightning, wind, thunder, light, and explosive-based magic. Rossweisse can fly via magic.

entries.name: Riser Phenex
entries.content: Riser Phenex is the third son of the Phenex Clan after his elder brother and a second older brother. He is the youngest son of Lord Phenex and Lady Phenex, the younger brother of Ruval Phenex and an older brother, and the older brother of Ravel Phenex. He was once Rias Gremory’s fiancé when they were in an arranged marriage. He has inherited the powers of the immortal bird, Phoenix, granting him immortality and instant regeneration. His all-female peerage consists of fourteen members. Riser is a tall and handsome young man in his early 20's with short blond hair and dark blue eyes. His outfit consists of a burgundy blazer with gold embroidery on the right with matching pants and black dress shoes. Underneath his open blazer is a white dress shirt that is not fully buttoned (just one button short), giving a slight view to his chest. Riser was an arrogant, aggressive playboy with a holier-than-thou personality. He was condescending towards lower-class Devils. Despite this, Riser does have an honorable side. Like most devils, Riser has no good opinion about humans or the Human World. Later, after he failed to have Rias, Riser got slightly depressed. Riser is a pervert, not only purposely creating an all female peerage, but also his desire to see Rias and Akeno's breasts. After recovering from his trauma, Riser seems to have reformed from his old ways, becoming more humble and respectful, but still bit of a pervert. As a Devil, Riser has all the common skills and powers of one, including the power to cast spells. Riser can teleport himself to any location. Coming from the Phenex Clan, Riser is able to create and control powerful flames. Riser's hellfire was stated to give off demonic power comparable to Rias, and his attacks left scratch marks on Issei's Overboost Scale Mail. Riser has Enhanced Strength and Durability. He is Expert Hand-to-Hand Combat and can fly using his fiery wings.

entries.name: Ravel Phenex
entries.content: Ravel Phenex is the only daughter and youngest child of Lord Phenex and Lady Phenex, and the younger sister of Ruval Phenex, an unnamed older brother and Riser Phenex. She is a second-year high school student at Kuoh Academy and a former member of Riser's peerage. Like her older brothers, she has inherited the powers of the Phoenix and possesses the power of fire, wind, and immortality. Upon Riser's defeat, she is traded to her mother's peerage. Ravel is a beautiful young girl with dark blue eyes. She has long blonde hair tied into twintails with large, drill-like curls and blue ribbons keeping them in place. The front of her hair has several bangs hanging over her forehead, with a V-shaped fringe hanging over the bridge of her nose. Ravel's body measurements are B85-W59-H84 cm, height is 153 cm and body weight is 47 kg. Ravel was spoiled, arrogant and snobbish at first. But she is also well-mannered, modest, elegant, and polite young girl, initially harsh towards those whom she dislikes. Ravel is attracted to Issei Hyoudou, and later falls in love with him, albeit in a tsundere manner. She does not really mind being one of Issei's "servants", or his "concubines", just as long as she can continue to be by his side, desiring to be traded as one of Issei's Bishops when he gains a peerage, for she only wishes to be of use to him. Despite her young age, she's very intelligent, mature and perceptive, being able to understand the atmosphere of any situation as well as surmise thoughts just by simply looking at people. She is gifted strategist. Ravel appears as quite strict as she has her own expectations and standards when it comes to the suitability of serving. Ravel has a ruthless side, being relentless in securing victory for her team. Despite her maturity, Ravel is also stubborn and childish at times, having a habit of wanting other people's belongings. As a Devil, Ravel has all the common skills and powers of one, including the power to cast spells. As a member of the Phenex Clan, Ravel can create and control powerful flames noted to be strong enough to burn Scale Mail armor.

entries.name: Riser Phenex's Peerage
entries.content: Members of Riser's Peerage are Yubelluna, Mihae, Karlamine, Siris, Isabela, Xuelan, Ile and Nel, Ni and Li, Marion, Bülent, Shuriya and Mira.

entries.name: Phenex
entries.content: The Phenex Clan is one of the remaining 32 Devil Clans of the 72 Pillars and holds the rank of Marquis. The next heir to the Phenex clan is Ruval Phenex. The Phenex Family have inherent powers that are equivalent to that of the legendary creature, the firebird Phoenix. As such, their abilities reflect that of the legendary bird, where they can regenerate from almost any injury immediately and are practically impossible to defeat. It is said that the Phenex family's tears (known as Phoenix Tears) sell for a high price in Devil society and the supernatural world because of their powerful healing abilities, resulting in the Phenex Family's immense wealth. Members of the Phenex Clan, earned their renown from their three demonic powers, in which was similar to the Phoenix, Suzaku, and Fenghuang. Their power of Immortality, lets them regenerate body parts in flames, which restores them to their previous conditions in flames, making them difficult opponents for those without immense power; powerful flames able to incinerate most opponents and wound Dragons. The Phenex Clan have a special magic ritual which allows them to create Phoenix Tears, by adding their tears that is shed with an empty mind into a cup of water which also went through a special ritual, granting the water powerful healing abilities. The magic ritual requires a Pure Blooded Phenex Devil to be effective. Members of the Phenex Clan have wings of fire, instead of the bat-like wings possessed by most Devils, although these are seemingly made from their power rather then being a physical part of them, as they can't maintain their form when the Phenex in question is weakened. The clan symbol of the Phenex consists of a phoenix encased in a circular shape. Their magic circles also have a unique flair, in which flames erupt from it whenever a Phenex Clan member appears.

entries.name: 72 Pillars
entries.content: The 72 Pillars are the 72 devil families that rule the Underworld. The number of families that still exist is 32 while the remaining 40 families are said to be extinct, but a few of the devils of these families/bloodlines are still alive. In addition to that, some clans are considered to be extinct despite having pure-blooded high class devils in them. The famlies are Bael (Great King), Agares (Archduke), Vassago, Gamigin, Marbas (extinct), Valefor (extinct), Amon, Barbatos, Paimon, Buer (extinct), Gusion (extinct), Sitr (Prince), Beleth, Leraje (extinct), Eligos (extinct), Zepar, Botis (extinct), Bathin (extinct), Sallo, Purson, Marax (extinct), Ipos (extinct), Aim (extinct), Naberius, Glasya-Labolas (Count), Buné (extinct), Ronové (extinct), Berith, Astaroth (Duke), Forneus, Foras (extinct), Asmoday, Gäap (extinct), Furfur, Marchosias (extinct), Stolas, Phenex (Marquis), Halphas (extinct), Malphas (extinct), Raim (extinct), Focalor (extinct), Vepar (extinct), Sabnock (extinct), Shax, Viné (extinct), Bifrons (extinct), Uvall, Häagenti (extinct), Crocell (extinct), Furcas, Balam, Alocer (extinct), Caim (extinct), Murmur (extinct), Orobas (extinct), Gremory (Duke), Ose (extinct), Amy (extinct), Oriax, Vapula, Zagan (extinct), Valac, Andras (extinct), Flauros (extinct), Andrealphus, Cimerius (extinct), Amduscias (extinct), Belial (King), Decarabia (extinct), Seere (extinct), Dantalion and Andromalius (extinct).

entries.name: Four Great Satans
entries.content: The Four Great Satans are the original rulers of the Underworld and leaders of the Devils. They were named Lucifer, Beelzebub, Leviathan, and Asmodeus. The four original Devil Kings desiring world domination led the Devils against God and the Angels in Heaven as well as Azazel and the Fallen Angels in the Great War. The Four Great Devil Kings eventually died in the Great War after more than half of the 72 Pillars as well as a majority of the armies of Devils that serve the High-Class Devil Clans of the 72 Pillars were wiped out. The Satan positions are given to Sirzechs Lucifer (of the Gremory Clan), Serafall Leviathan (of the Sitri Clan), Ajuka Beelzebub (of the Astaroth Clan), and Falbium Asmodeus (of the Glasya-Labolas Clan). Four Devils who were born with immense power, equivalent or superior to the original four and were chosen for the Satans' positions despite not carrying the blood of the original Satans. Three of the descendants of the original Satans are Katerea Leviathan, Shalba Beelzebub, and Creuserey Asmodeus.

entries.name: Irina Shidou
entries.content: Irina Shidou is a third-year high school student at Kuoh Academy in Class 3-B and is a devout Christian who, even after learning of God's death, still follows his teachings. She is childhood friend of Issei Hyoudou. Irina is a beautiful young woman with violet eyes. She has long chestnut hair that is usually tied into twintails, each held with a blue scrunchy, but on some occasions, she lets her hair down. Her body measurements are B87-W59-H89 cm, height is 164 cm and body weight is 56 kg. She wears the standard Church battle attire, same as Xenovia's with some slight differences. After transferring to Kuoh Academy and moving into the Hyoudou Residence, she starts wearing the Kuoh Academy girls' school uniform, with black short shorts under her skirt and the addition of white sneakers with blue accents. Irina is a cheerful, goofy, upbeat, and enthusiastic person. She is cooperative and open-minded to others. She is a fiercely devout Christian, having great respect for God's teachings. The death of God of the Bible was a great shock for Irina, yet she still believes in his teachings and transferred her belief to Michael who is the current "God". Irina is innocent, honest, respectful, and friendly. Irina has a strong but subconscious eroticism of her own. Irina is an artificial Holy Sword user, able to wield Excalibur Mimic and later Hauteclere. While she can't match up to the likes of Yuuto, Irina is still noticeably fast due to her training as an Exorcist. Irina is very strong, strong enough that the force of her swings could create wind. Irina is talented in swordsmanship, specialized in tricky movements that makes use of her speed.

entries.name: Kuroka Toujou
entries.content:
Kuroka is a Nekoshou, a rare variant of Nekomata. She is the older sister of Koneko Toujou, making her the firstborn daughter of Fujimai and her human lover. After their parent's deaths, she and her sister were turned by the Naberius clan into reincarnated Devils. To raise Koneko after becoming orphans. After killing her previous master to protect her sister, Kuroka became an SS-Class Stray Devil, one of the most wanted criminals. She soon became a member of the Vali Team, who were previously affiliated with the Khaos Brigade, she was exonerated from her previous crimes because of her actions. Kuroka is a beautiful young woman with a voluptuous figure, long black hair with split bangs, and hazel-gold eyes with cat-like pupils. Her body measurements are B98-W57-H86 cm, height is 161 cm and body weight is 49 kg. Her attire consists of a black kimono, a yellow obi, a set of golden beads, and an ornately detailed headband. The kimono features a red interior and it is open at her shoulders, giving view to her large breasts which rival those of Rias and Akeno in terms of size. In her Nekomata form, which she is in all the time, she grows a pair of black cat ears and two black tails. At first, Kuroka is rather malicious. Under normal circumstances, Kuroka is rather playful, nonchalant, and simple-minded, simply enjoying teasing people. She's rather vulgar, often using her beauty and sensuousness as a weapon, most notably Issei. Kuroka is lustful and perverted and is proud of her sex appeal and breasts. Despite her mischievous nature, she can be a kind and compassionate woman who loves Koneko more than anything, wanting peace more than anyone. She has an interest in having strong children, at first having propositioned Vali, but was rejected. Her reason being because she wanted her species, the Nekoshou, to bloom once again. Adding to her feline personality, Kuroka often ends her sentences with "Nya".


As a Devil, Kuroka has all the common skills and powers of one, including the power to cast various spells. She primarily uses this in tandem with her Immense Magical power of Senjutsu and Youjutsu techniques. Kuroka's power rivals that of an Ultimate-Class Devil. As a Nekoshou, she is highly talented in Youjutsu, being able to perform spells common among Youkai, whether for offense, defense, or support. She can create a poisonous mist effective on Youkai and Devils, but Dragons and Dragons-based Sacred Gear users are immune to it. Kuroka is able to cast illusions. Kuroka became exceptional in Senjutsu, strengthening herself using Ki and sensing auras. She can control nature and can combine Senjutsu and Youjutsu to release a concentrated energy blast. Kuroka can transport herself and others to different locations. Kuroka can perform spatial manipulation. Kuroka has some skills in hand-to-hand combat.

entries.name: Grigori
entries.content: Grigori is an organization created by Azazel and the Cadre Fallen Angels who fell from the grace of God of the Bible in Heaven after they gave in to their impure thoughts. Originally from the Fifth Heaven, the Grigori were once Pure Angels that was created by the God of the Bible until they fell from Heaven for giving into their impure thoughts and having sex with Human women. Azazel and the Grigori participated in the Great War against God and the Angels in Heaven and the original Four Great Satans and the Devils, but after God and the Satans were killed, the Grigori became the first to retreat after losing many of their subordinates. The Grigori had a strict policy of not causing harm to the Human world. Leaders include Shemhazai as a Governor General, Baraqiel	as a Vice Governor General. Executives include Benemune as Chief Secretary and Tamiel as Head of Business Department. Researchers are Armaros as Researcher of Anti-Magic and Sahariel as Researcher of the Moon. Azazel is the leader of the Grigori.

entries.name: Azazel
entries.content: Azazel is the Leader of the Fallen Angels and Grigori. Azazel is a tall man appearing to be in his twenties with an average build, black hair, golden bangs, and black goatee. He also possesses twelve jet-black feathered wings that grow out from his back. Azazel wears a V-neck maroon long-coat with a wide, open high-collar that opens up at the hem. The long-coat also featured two black belts around the waist and four black bands on each arm, two of the bands at the wrist and the other two near the elbow. He wore grey slacks and brown shoes. Azazel is laid-back yet serious, while also wise and insane at the same time. His character seems to reflect upon the situation at hand. Azazel loves to collect things (like video games consoles) and a research fanatic, especially on Sacred Gears. He is a pacifistic, preferring to talk his way out of troubles rather than resorting to violence. He cares deeply for his fellow Fallen Angels. Azazel is extremely charismatic, being able to endear his Fallen Angel followers. Azazel has complicated feelings about the fact that many of his friends and acquaintances are all married and have a family. Azazel is perverted because of his fondness for breasts, and has had hundreds of harems over the millennia. The reason for becoming a Fallen Angel all those millennia ago was lust. Even before he became a Fallen Angel, he was already a pervert as he would fantasize about touching/seeing Gabriel's breasts. Azazel is very compassionate as he would do whatever he can to help people in need. He adopted Vali Lucifer and cared for him as his own son. As a Fallen Angel, Azazel has the ability to use light power to create various effects. His light powers are superior among other fallen angels. Azazel has immense strength rivaling Satan-Class Devils, rivaling the Archangel, Michael. Azazel has remarkable durability and pain tolerance. Azazel is capable of moving at God-like speed, being able to appear behind his opponents without them noticing. Azazel is an extremely masterful combatant, having centuries worth of combat experience. Azazel has extremely proficient in spearmanship. As one of the greatest minds in the supernatural world, Azazel has near impeccable intellect, memory, and knowledge measuring from his centuries of experience and research. Azazel is also a master battle tactician. Azazel has immense knowledge on Christianity. Azazel is a highly skilled and experienced politician, particularly in diplomacy. Azazel is a master of magic with immense magic knowledge and experience. Azazel is very skilled in hiding his presence, something even Rias and Yuuto was unable to detect.

entries.name: Vali Lucifer
entries.content:
Vali Lucifer is the remaining descendant of the original Lucifer and the leader of the Vali Team that was previously affiliated with the Khaos Brigade. He is the wielder of the Longinus; Divine Dividing, being the possessor of the Vanishing Dragon, Albion. As such, he is the direct rival of Issei Hyoudou and Ddraig. Vali is a handsome young man with dark silver hair and light blue eyes. He is often seen wearing a dark green V-neck shirt with a high-collared black leather jacket over it. He also wears burgundy jeans with a silver chain drooping down over them and black leather chaps with three bands encircling his right calf, and black shoes with black buckles. Vali has eight pairs of black bat-like wings on his back. Vali also bears a great resemblance to his grandfather, Rizevim Livan Lucifer. Vali's height is 168 cm and body weight is 60 kg.

He initially can be cold, arrogant, overconfident, and ruthless person, But Vali has a calm, noble, and caring side to him, as he cares deeply for his comrades. Wielding the Longinus "Divine Dividing" and his demonic powers, he refuses to use any other weapon besides the two. He is a prideful young man and a battle maniac, being obsessed with finding strong opponents and would gladly welcome death if there was no one strong enough for him to fight. Vali has absolutely no interest in world domination due to his humility and realistic worldview. Vali shows a proper attitude towards beings that deserve respect. Vali has a more vulnerable side, a side that he almost never shows. This side of him comes from the extreme abuse and persecution that Vali suffered at his father's hand. Vali's deepest desire is to have a family. Vali has repeatedly done selfless acts of kindness. Vali's strong resolve to protect his mother also extends to his younger half-siblings. Aside from battles, Vali is also utterly obsessed with noodles, in particular, ramen. His devotion to his ramen research is such that he would travel between the Human world, the Underworld, and other mythological locations to procure special ingredients for his own ramen recipe. Vali has extreme lack of interest in the opposite sex, having no interest in romance since he was a child. When pressed by Odin, Vali reveals that he has a slight fetish for women's butts. As the original Lucifer's great-grandson, he has extraordinary Demonic Power, and talent superior to other Satan descendants which he developed further through dedicated training since childhood in order to surpass his father and grandfather. Vali is extremely durable with high pain tolerance which he developed from his childhood. Vali has incredible speed, and tremendous stamina and endurance. Vali is a highly intelligent genius. While under Azazel, he has acquired incredible knowledge on various mythologies, supernatural beings, and Sacred Gears. Having an interest in exploration and archaeology. Vali is extremely proficient combatant. Vali is extremely talented in using magic, most frequently Devil Magic enhanced by his demonic power. Divine Dividing is his sacred gear and sole weapon. It takes form as a pair of light wings, enabling high-speed flight, while working opposite to the Boosted Gear, where it divides his target's power in half every 10-seconds, the halved power it added onto his; reaching his maximum limit, the excess power it released through his wings. Vali can use Half-Dimension without Balance Breaker, and gained Reflect, letting him redirect incoming attacks.

entries.name: Serafall Sitri
entries.content: Serafall Leviathan, formerly known as Serafall Sitri, is the Satan Leviathan who is in charge of Foreign Affairs. She is the former heiress of the Sitri Clan and the eldest daughter of Lord and Lady Sitri, and the older sister of Sona Sitri. During the war between the Old Satan Faction and Anti Satan Faction, she was part of the Anti Satan Faction that opposed the Old Satan Faction, which ended in their victory, and she was eventually promoted to the position of Satan Leviathan, losing her right as the heir of the Sitri Clan. Serafall is a beautiful girl; looking in her late teens with black hair, tied into twin tails and Pink eyes. She also has a child-like body, albeit with large breasts. Her body measurements are B85-W56-H80 cm, height is 160 cm and body weight is 48 kg. Due to her hobby and interest in magical girls, she ocassionally dresses in magical girl's clothing, magic wand and all, and taking the nickname "Satan Girl". Outside of her hobby, Serafall would wear noble woman clothing when fulfilling her political duties as a Satan. Serafall is cheerful, friendly and has a childlike personality. While intially skeptical about having siblings, Serafall also has a deep sister complex which she developed after Sona was born as she excessively doted on her younger sister, and has a tendency to get her into embarrassing situations. Despite her childlike nature, Serafall can also be selfless and determined. As the current Leviathan, Serafall is a highly powerful Devil. Serafall's demonic power specializes in ice manipulation. Serafall's signature technique converts the land itself into a frozen wonderland. Serafall is very adept at magic, enhanced by her demonic power. Serafall is well adept in using fire magic. Serafall has the ability to teleport herself and others. Serafall is a highly skilled and talented diplomat in handling negotiations, having an idol like charisma that contributed to her talent in diplomancy. Serafall is a talented and charismatic idol and actress who perform in her own magical girl TV show called Miracle☆Levia-tan.

entries.name: Sona Sitri
entries.content: Sona Sitri is the heiress of the Sitri Clan, taking the position since her older sister, Serafall Leviathan, who became one of the Four Great Satans. As such, she is the youngest daughter of Lord Sitri and Lady Sitri. She is a first-year college student at Kuoh Academy, the former President of Kuoh Academy's Student Council, and a childhood friend and rival of Rias Gremory. Her alias at Kuoh Academy is Souna Shitori and she is the third most popular girl at the Academy, behind Rias and Akeno Himejima. Sona is a bespectacled young woman with a slim figure, black hair styled in a short bob cut, and violet eyes. Her body measurements are B77-W57-H83 cm, her height is 166 cm and her body weight is 51 kg. Sona is highly strict and serious person, unforgiving even towards her own servants for getting into trouble. She does not take anything lightly. Despite her strict nature, Sona is also kind, generous, and compassionate. Sona's wish for opening a school was also to provide more education opportunities for lower-class devils in the Underworld who are restricted by an aristocratic society that limits their chances to learn. Sona is also proud of her intellect, as she refused to marry a man who is not her intellectual equal or superior. Despite being mostly calm and serious, Sona has an emotional and delicate side, such as her fragile ego when it comes to baking cakes,, which she is quite bad at. Sona is also extremely attached to her older sister Serafall who has excessively doted on her since childhood. As a teenager, Sona is often embarrassed by her sister's childish behavior. Despite this, Sona cares deeply for Serafall and is very protective of her. As a High-Class Devil, Sona has considerable demonic power and talent which she developed through dedicated training. Her technique in handling demonic power surpasses Rias. Sona is very proficient in Devil magic, enhanced by her demonic power. As a member of the Sitri Clan, Sona has high affinity for water magic, with her technical control surpassing that of Rias, able to change the water’s form, creating various creatures out of the water, such as multiple hawks, serpents, valiant lions, wolves, and several large Dragons. Sona is extremely intelligent with incredible foresight. Her intellect is reflected in her talents in strategies, academics, and pedagogy. Sona is a skilled actress, having effectively take over her older sister magical girl TV show Miracle☆Levia-tan, even successfully imitate Serafall's personality and enthusiasm.
